kev_metadata.requiredAction: This vulnerability affects legacy D-Link products. All associated hardware revisions have reached their end-of-life (EOL) or end-of-service (EOS) life cycle and should be retired and replaced per vendor instructions.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-605 routers contain an information disclosure vulnerability that allows attackers to obtain a username and password by forging a post request to the /getcfg.php page.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-605 Router Information Disclosure Vulnerability

title: D-Link DIR-605 Router Information Disclosure Vulnerability
